svg.aria-label: How the four projects fit: ghosttea, mille and flux each use truffle, and flux also uses mille
svg.title: How the four projects fit: ghosttea, mille and flux each use truffle, and flux also uses mille
svg.desc: Three boxes in a row: ghosttea, a terminal; mille, a file tree; flux, a media server. Each has a line down to truffle, which gives direct connections between your own devices, on Tailscale. ghosttea's line carries shared sessions, to a desktop or an iPhone. mille's carries remote workspaces, which are experimental. flux's is its own tailnet node, which is optional. A fourth line joins mille to flux: flux scans your library with mille.
